security_audit.summary: Most external command findings are false positives from Markdown backticks and fenced bash examples, not hidden Ruby execution. The skill intentionally depends on the belt CLI and external service links, so the remaining risk is disclosed third-party service and supply-chain exposure. No evidence of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or obfuscated commands was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Document that prompts and media workflow data may be sent to inference.sh providers. Advise users not to include confidential campaign data.

remediation.issue: Remote install instructions on a mutable branch
remediation.suggestion: Prefer version-pinned install guidance or a tagged URL instead of a raw main-branch GitHub URL.

remediation.issue: CLI examples require user trust in belt apps
remediation.suggestion: Keep command examples limited to explicit belt invocations and avoid shell pipes, redirects, or dynamic command fragments.

content.value_statement: Video ad teams waste time adapting creative to different platform rules. This skill gives format specs, structure templates, and production prompts for faster ad planning.
actual_capabilities: Lists aspect ratios, resolutions, duration ranges, and safe zones for major social ad platforms.
Explains AIDA timing for short-form video ads.
Provides hook, caption, and CTA guidance for mobile feeds.
Shows belt CLI examples for video, voiceover, audio merge, and caption generation.
Includes ad structure templates for testimonial, demo, and before-after concepts.
limitations: Requires the belt CLI and an inference.sh account for generation examples.
Platform policies and specs may change after the skill was written.
Does not verify media files, campaign settings, budgets, or ad account compliance.
Generated prompts still need brand, legal, and accessibility review.

use_cases.title: Plan a Paid Social Launch
use_cases.description: Map one product offer into platform-specific video ad formats with durations, ratios, and CTA timing.

use_cases.title: Prepare Creator-Style Variations
use_cases.description: Turn a campaign idea into short hooks, scene beats, captions, and vertical video prompts.

use_cases.title: Build a Production Checklist
use_cases.description: Check every ad concept for safe zones, captions, aspect ratio, sound design, and platform fit.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Platform Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use video-ad-specs to plan a 15-second TikTok ad for [product]. Include aspect ratio, hook, scene beats, captions, and CTA.

prompt_templates.title: Cross-Platform Adaptation
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this ad concept for Instagram Reels, YouTube bumper, Facebook Feed, and LinkedIn. List the format changes for each platform.

prompt_templates.title: Caption And Hook Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft video ad structure. Flag weak hooks, missing captions, unsafe text zones, duration issues, and CTA timing problems.

prompt_templates.title: Production-Ready Generation Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production brief for a multi-scene video ad using belt-compatible generation steps. Include visual prompts, voiceover direction, captions, and merge steps.

output_examples.input: I need a 15-second Instagram Reels ad for a wireless charger.
output: Opening hook: show tangled cables in the first second.
Scene plan: problem, product reveal, benefit proof, CTA.
Caption notes: high contrast, two lines maximum, avoid bottom UI space.

output_examples.input: Adapt a software demo ad for YouTube bumper and LinkedIn feed.
output: YouTube bumper: six seconds, one message, fast product montage, logo at the end.
LinkedIn feed: square or widescreen format, professional tone, clear business outcome.
Both versions need captions because autoplay may be silent.

output_examples.input: Review this TikTok ad outline before production.
output_examples.output: The review would check hook strength, platform duration, vertical framing, safe zones, caption readability, and CTA placement.

best_practices: Start each ad with one clear visual hook in the first three seconds.
Create separate aspect-ratio versions instead of cropping one master video.
Plan captions and safe zones before generating or editing scenes.
anti_patterns: Using one landscape video across vertical platforms.
Adding important text near platform UI areas.
Delaying the CTA until viewers have likely skipped.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers TikTok, Instagram Reels, Instagram Stories, YouTube, Facebook Feed, and LinkedIn.

faq.question: Does it generate videos by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning guidance and belt CLI examples. Generation requires belt and an inference.sh account.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Are the ad specs guaranteed current?
faq.answer: No. Platform rules can change. Verify current platform documentation before launching paid campaigns.

faq.question: Does it help with captions?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains caption requirements, readability rules, and a caption burn-in workflow.

faq.question: Is it suitable for regulated ads?
faq.answer: It can structure creative, but it does not replace legal, platform, or industry compliance review.
